title: Async Retry Policy with Exponential Backoff

story.action: need reliable error handling for transient failures in async operations
story.benefit: to ensure the AI Multi-Agent System gracefully handles network issues, rate limits, and temporary service disruptions without failing user requests

requirements.description: Async retry decorator with configurable max_attempts (default: 3)
Exponential backoff delay between retries (base_delay: 1.0s, max_delay: 30.0s)
Jitter support (default: 0.1) to prevent thundering herd problem
Retry on connection errors, timeouts, 429 rate limits, and 500+ server errors
Do NOT retry on 401 authentication errors and 400 bad requests
Log each retry attempt with attempt number and delay
Raise RetryExhaustedError when all attempts are exhausted
Customizable retry_on and do_not_retry_on exception tuples

acceptance_criteria.description: Function decorated with @async_retry succeeds after transient failures
Delay between retries follows exponential backoff: 1s, 2s, 4s with base_delay=1.0
Jitter adds randomness (+/-10%) to prevent synchronized retries
ConnectionError triggers retry; ValueError (in do_not_retry_on) does not
All retry attempts and final exhaustion are logged at WARNING/ERROR level
